column1: # The steps of scripts/stability.sh. Tab separated: step, budget row of scripts/budgets.tsv, cluster (1: a scripts/pgtest.sh cluster is started for the command), est_s (the measured seconds of the
# release build on this host, the order of the queue), command (run from the repository root; SIFT_TMP, SIFT_PORT, SIFT_ROOT and SIFT_INITDB_TEMPLATE are set per lane).
# @pool KEY SEEDS: the pool a fuzzer or oracle draws its seeds from; {seeds:KEY:COUNT:SLOT} is the COUNT seeds of SLOT in the window of the round (scripts/stability.sh).
# The oracle seeds 1-12 are the 12 profiles (3 shapes x walk/plain x late/not); 3 of them a round, so 4 rounds cover them, and the mutant check (SIFT_ORACLE_MUTANT=only) runs once a round.
